{"body":"Cause: (*Store).Get in store/store.go returned (nil, nil) for a reminder whose tombstone was still in the map (case r.Deleted: r = nil, with err left nil), even though its contract says deleted reminders are not returned. Any caller that checks only the error then dereferences the nil reminder.

Evidence: crash reports cr_1e2ea0 (2x, POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done at 14:12-14:13) and cr_ee551c (GET /v1/reminders/rem_0001 at 14:15), all panicking at api/reminders.go:144 (rem.UserID != u.ID). The log for rem_0001 shows "reminder created ... 14:09:46" then "DELETE /v1/reminders/rem_0001 204 ... 14:11:02" — the requests crashed only after the delete. The same (nil, nil) also threatens api/lists.go:56 and api/search.go:31, which call viewOf(rem) after an err==nil check.

Fix: store.Get now sets err = ErrNotFound in the r.Deleted case, so deleted reminders look exactly like missing ones; owned, lists, and search all answer/skip with 404 as intended.

Reproducer: api/deleted_test.go TestDeletedReminderGone — create, delete, then GET and POST done on the same ID; it failed on the old code (500 from the recovered nil-deref panic) and passes now, as does store/get_deleted_test.go TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound at the unit level.","fingerprint":"fp_4828a6","title":"store.Get returns (nil, nil) for a deleted reminder, panicking api.owned"}
